subject: parser, ddl: Add parser support for default value as column (#61498)
summary: Reviewed the parser-only change: `pkg/parser/parser.y` adds `DefaultValueExpr: '(' Identifier ')'` producing `*ast.ColumnNameExpr`, and `pkg/parser/ast/ddl.go` restores such defaults with outer parentheses. Checked for grammar/semantic collisions: special defaults (`CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`, `CURRENT_DATE`, sequence nextval) are matched by earlier `DefaultValueExpr` alternatives, and literals (`NULL/TRUE/FALSE/numbers/strings`) don’t route through `Identifier`, so existing parses aren’t plausibly regressed. Parser/AST restore tests cover `DEFAULT (col)` acceptance and `DEFAULT col` rejection.
